title_en: Technology and Engineering (13/20): Servers in a Data Center
note_en: The pattern 越……就越…… means "the more..., the more...": PUE数值越接近1，数据中心就越高效 "the closer the PUE is to 1, the more efficient the data center." Where English puts "the more" at the front of each clause, Chinese places 越 right before the verb or adjective in each half, after the subject, and usually adds 就 in the second half.
